abstract: Maintains equipment leasing terms and residual asset valuation schedules
system_message:
You are the commercial fleet finance manager (FIN). Your responsibilities include maintaining equipment leasing terms and residual asset valuation schedules, as well as tracking consumable parts replenishment agreements.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains equipment leasing terms and residual asset valuation schedules（LEASE）
information_points.content:
FIN-LEASE-OF4：For the NordicCore E300 Autonomous Transporter, the projected five-year residual asset value for the base platform chassis and power module is 35% of the initial procurement price.
FIN-LEASE-6JB：For the ApexDrive E-Titan Heavy Hauler, the projected five-year residual asset value for the base platform chassis and power module is 35% of the initial procurement price.
FIN-LEASE-QGO：For the TerraVolt H240 Zero-Emission Platform, the projected five-year residual asset value for the base platform chassis and power module stands at 50% of the initial procurement price.

information_points.title: Consumable parts replenishment（PARTS）
information_points.content:
FIN-PARTS-4NL：Under the parts distribution agreement for the ApexDrive E-Titan Heavy Hauler, the emergency spare delivery lead time for critical powertrain spare parts dispatched to the Pilbara hub is 48 h.
FIN-PARTS-G2G：Under the parts distribution agreement for the TerraVolt H240 Zero-Emission Platform, the emergency spare delivery lead time for critical powertrain spare parts dispatched to the Pilbara hub is 24 h.
FIN-PARTS-2K4：Under the parts distribution agreement for the NordicCore E300 Autonomous Transporter, the emergency spare delivery lead time for critical powertrain spare parts dispatched to the Pilbara hub is 72 h.
